items.title: Film from any side
items.body: Front, side or 45°, no buttons. The screen edge shows if you're in frame, and weight is asked only when it can't be read.

items.title: Coach's AI asks first
items.body: Pick what Coach's AI may see. Change it any time in Settings → Account → AI & privacy.

items.title: How it works, with the science
items.body: Every rule cites its studies. New topics: Warm-up, Pain, Life stages and Coach.

items.title: Me keeps the tab bar
items.body: Your profile and Settings open inside the tab you're on.

items.title: Lots of little fixes
items.body: Skip a climb after your workout, Watch follows your After the last set setting, longer Coach chats.
